questions.q: In "Outcomes Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Avoid vague words such as understand or know when you write the outcome, because you cannot see them.

questions.q: In "Know your learners Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Take attendance at every session and write short notes on what worked and what did not straight after teaching.

questions.q: In "Assessment Create", which of these is a key idea?
